comments.author: Chester
comments.body: I found this to be one of the best items to take for nanban trading short distance trade wise (providing the backstock for fragrances isn't too high) and it works for all 4 EA nations.

comments.author: Meng Meng
comments.body: One problem: You can only buy these at Calicut and Cochin which is camped by pirates 75% of the time... and there's no way to make/collect these either.

comments.author: Io
comments.body: Leshan Middle/Lower drops this trade good, too.

comments.author: Nekos
comments.body: Available at Ancona during 15th century period 1 & 2 which is currently on GAMA.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: This sells for about 4,800D in the Northern France area at 100% with similar prices elsewhere in Europe. AS Chester said this is a excellent good to bring to nanban trade in EA if your willing to brave the waters around Calicut and Cochin...
